ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_004_cost_scaled_normalized_clamped_weight_stable_grad
ir.intuition: Improved stability and fixed affine invariance violation by further reducing the scaled cost factor to 0.01 for smoother gradient dynamics. Added normalization of cost_gap by absolute delta plus epsilon to prevent division instability. Maintained clamping of intermediate logits difference inputs and weights to avoid extreme values. These changes reduce sensitivity to objective perturbations, stabilizing gradient ratios.
ir.pseudocode:
eps = 1e-6
delta = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
abs_delta = abs(delta) + eps
scaled_cost = 0.01 * cost_gap / abs_delta
x_raw = alpha * scale * delta - scaled_cost
x = clamp(x_raw, -10, 10)
weight_clamped = clamp(weight, 1e-6, 10.0)
losses = -logsigmoid(x)
loss = sum(losses * weight_clamped) / sum(weight_clamped)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
    delta = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    abs_delta = ops.add(ops.abs(delta), eps)
    scaled_cost = ops.div(ops.mul(0.01, cost_gap), abs_delta)
    x_raw = ops.sub(ops.mul(ops.mul(alpha, scale), delta), scaled_cost)
    x = ops.clamp(x_raw, -10.0, 10.0)
    weight_clamped = ops.clamp(weight, 1e-6, 10.0)
    losses = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_sum = ops.sum(ops.mul(losses, weight_clamped))
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight_clamped)
    loss = weighted_sum / ops.clamp(weight_sum, 1e-6, 1e6)
    return loss
